page.overview:
Who is Keif Villari?

Keif Villari was a Dune Men and a presenter on the Communinet Radio.

Keif Villari often gave advice to his fellow Dune Men over the radio to ensure that they could operate safely and make a sizable profit. He would advise them on the importance of keeping their equipment sanitized to ensure that it could be operated to its full capacity.
